title_zh: 比特币 1–5 分钟短线信号
original_description: This TradingView Pine Script indicator provides high-probability scalping signals for Bitcoin (BTC) on 1 to 5 minute timeframes. It combines multiple technical indicators like EMA crossovers, RSI, and MACD to generate buy/sell signals, making it ideal for short-term crypto traders.
description_zh: 作者称该指标面向比特币 1 至 5 分钟图，结合 EMA 交叉、RSI 和 MACD 生成买卖信号，供短线交易使用；作者对信号概率的描述未经验证。
author: Abhii58
